sammendrag: A literature review examined how literacy programs can assess their effectiveness by looking at outcomes and using this information. Very few empirical studies showed the impacts of literacy programs or identified predictors of program success. One reason was the lack of common criteria for evaluating performance. One evaluation issue was whether the same measures should be used to assess both individual progress, and program effectiveness. Results of the U.S. National Evaluation of Adult Education Programs (NEAEP) showed that using the same types of measures across programs allowed discovery of what programicomponents most affected outcomes. The NAEAP study was also used to investigate research on variables assumed to be linked to program effectiveness.
